sources.name: Conflict Investigations NZZ Maps territory series
sources.role: Occupied-area time series derived by the upstream project

methodology: Monthly and yearly summaries derived from the normalized daily occupied-area series. The start value is the latest observation before the period and the end value is its last observation, so net change includes the first dated movement inside the period. No missing observations are interpolated.
license_notice: No blanket license is granted for this collection. Each upstream source retains its own rights and terms. Review the source-specific terms and preserve attribution before reuse.

provenance.methodology: Join records to data by period_type and period. Endpoint quality classifies net change independently from internal carried-forward records. Min/max flags identify extrema that include carried-forward estimates. Clean endpoints can establish the observed net movement despite an internal source gap; they do not establish the intervening path.
